titles.title: The Gloomy, Sexy Guy Next Door
รักร้ายของนายข้างบ้าน

description:
Every single day, I wanted to punch the lights out of the bastard next door who was constantly having sex. Eventually, I couldn't take it anymore and rang his doorbell, but—

"Ahh, your tongue... so this is what Yeo-Eul likes."

Because of the deadline for the damn sexual column she had to write, she made a huge mistake. So, it's only right to end it as a one-night stand, but—

"Now really... just one last time. Please?"

I don't know what to do with this "devoted man-whore" who clings to me more persistently the more I try to shake him off.

"Un-gyeol. Something dangerous has attached itself to you."

With those thunderbolt-like words, something sinister latched onto him. On a day when his life—already worse than death from chronic sleep deprivation—felt unbearable,

[It was hard to fall asleep because of the noise coming from your place last night.]

An exorcism talisman rolled in along with a yellow Post-it note. The deep sleep he had for the first time in five years was so sweet it felt like his tongue would melt.

"I'll treat you well, Yeo-Eul. You're my talisman, after all..."

Holding his breath as he gripped Yeo-Eul's ankle, he looked creepy and chilling.

"So please, like me a little... Only like me. Dote on me, okay?"

By the time she realized she had gotten caught by the wrong person, it was already too late.
